text.p: A stake of 10 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Monday at an average 3,015.78 roubles ($0.555) a share, up from 3,010.15 roubles at the previous auction on October 11, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Since auctions began in March 1996, 209.75 million shares, equivalent to 0.88 percent of the capital, have changed hands, the FFK said.
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.510 at 1315 GMT on Monday on the Russian Trading System on Monday, up from $0.470 on Friday.
The company is due to announce the pricing of an international offering of American Depositary Shares later on Monday.

The next auction will be held on October 30, when 10 million shares in 40 lots will be offered at a starting price of 2,865 roubles a share. Further auctions will be held on November 5, 13, 20 and 27.
